sourceClosed_iff_lowerSemicontinuous:
theorem sourceClosed_iff_lowerSemicontinuous (f : E → EReal) :
    SourceClosed f ↔ LowerSemicontinuous f
sourceClosed_indicator_iff:
theorem sourceClosed_indicator_iff (V : Set E) :
    SourceClosed (extendedIndicator V) ↔ IsClosed V
sourceProper_indicator_iff:
theorem sourceProper_indicator_iff (V : Set E) :
    SourceProper (extendedIndicator V) ↔ V.Nonempty
